Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to play and run around. One day, Max saw a big tree with a great view. He wanted to go inside and explore the world.
Max went outside and saw a big, red ball. He wanted to play with it, but it was too high for him to reach. Max tried and tried, but he could not reach the ball. He saw a bird with a nest far away. Max was sad and wanted to help the bird.
Max looked around and saw the bird with his ball. He thought, "Maybe the bird will come down and get the ball." Max climbed the tree and pushed the ball up to the branch. To his surprise, the ball came down with a loud noise. The ball broke into pieces. Max was very sad and cried
